main:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads test-case inputs containing people with positions and directions, simulates their directional rays on a q by q grid, and prints the maximum-covered coordinate selected by smallest transformed x+y, then smallest x, then smallest y." main]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> args </REF>: String[] "Command-line arguments; not used by the method."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Create a Scanner named sc that reads from System.in. RESULT sc]
            [COMMAND Read the first integer from sc into t as the number of test cases. RESULT t]
            [COMMAND Start an outer for loop with i = 1; continue while i <= t; increment i by 1 after each iteration. RESULT outer_loop]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop over i, read integer p as the number of people and integer q as the grid size from sc. RESULT p_and_q]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop over i, create an ArrayList named ppl with initial capacity p to store people. RESULT ppl]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop over i, start an inner for loop over j from 0 to p - 1 to read each person. RESULT person_read_loop]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop over i and the inner loop over j, read the person's y-coordinate b from sc, read the next integer from sc, compute a = q - thatInteger - 1, and read the direction string c from sc. RESULT person_input]
            [COMMAND Within the person reading loop, initialize d = 0 and e = 0; if c equals "N" set e = -1; else if c equals "S" set e = 1; else if c equals "E" set d = 1; else set d = -1. RESULT direction_components]
            [COMMAND Within the person reading loop, add a new Person(a, b, d, e) to ppl. RESULT ppl]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop over i, create a q by q int array named b initialized to zero to store ray coverage counts. RESULT b]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop over i, iterate over each Person a in ppl and assign local variables x = a.x and y = a.y. RESULT ray_loop]
            [COMMAND Within the ray update loop for each Person a, if a.xDir == 0, walk j from x + a.yDir while 0 <= j < q, stepping by a.yDir, and for each such j increment b[j][k] for every k from 0 to q - 1. RESULT vertical_ray_update]
            [COMMAND Within the ray update loop for each Person a, if a.xDir != 0, for every row j from 0 to q - 1, walk k from y + a.xDir while 0 <= k < q, stepping by a.xDir, and increment b[j][k]. RESULT horizontal_ray_update]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop over i, initialize max = 0; scan every cell b[j][k] for j from 0 to q - 1 and k from 0 to q - 1, updating max to the cell value whenever it is greater than max. RESULT max]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop over i, create integer arrays row and col each of length q * q and set num = 0; scan columns c from 0 to q - 1 and rows r from 0 to q - 1, and whenever b[r][c] == max, set row[num] = q - r - 1, col[num] = c, and increment num. RESULT candidate_arrays]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop over i, create ArrayList f with initial capacity q * q and set min = Integer.MAX_VALUE. RESULT f_and_min]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop over i, for j from 0 to num - 1, if row[j] + col[j] < min then set min = row[j] + col[j], clear f, and add a new Person(row[j], col[j], 0, 0); else if row[j] + col[j] == min, add that new Person to f. RESULT f]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop over i, create ArrayList g with initial capacity f.size() and set m = Integer.MAX_VALUE; for j from 0 to f.size() - 1, if m > f.get(j).x then set m = f.get(j).x, clear g, and add f.get(j); else if m == f.get(j).x, add f.get(j) to g. RESULT g]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop over i, set Person z = g.get(0); for j from 1 to g.size() - 1, if g.get(j).y < z.y then set z = g.get(j). RESULT z]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop over i, print "Case #" + i + ": " + z.y + " " + z.x. RESULT printed_output]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
